entities.summary: Gabriel-Marie Garrone was a French Catholic prelate who served as president of the Pontifical Council for Culture from 1982 to 1988. He previously served as prefect of the Congregation for Catholic Education from 1968 to 1980. He was named a cardinal by Pope Paul VI in 1967.
